ModMetaData.name: Total Fog
ModMetaData.author: Andreas Pardeike
ModMetaData.description:
Fog of war for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. Explore with colonists, animals, cameras and watchtowers. Configure vision, delayed unseen-event notifications, combat music, hidden-source audio and optional Silent Raids in the mod settings. Defaults: map fog and Combat/Anomaly music suppression are on. Hidden-source audio checks and delayed unseen-event notifications are off; the Wildlife tab remains available. Enable those information settings for stricter fog. Silent Raids, message discarding and hidden-source muting are optional and off by default. Existing saved settings are preserved.
Early version: broader compatibility is still being tested. Enable Harmony and use this instead of other Real Fog of War versions.
Feedback and support: https://discord.gg/G4r84eN7w6 Source and current testing status: https://github.com/pardeike/TotalFog
Independently maintained by Andreas Pardeike, based on Real Fog of War by Luca De Petrillo and the NWN continuation maintained by Mlie. Licensed under Apache 2.0; original credits are retained in NOTICE.md.
